title: 第19章 气海诅咒第20章 那我就当你答应了
lines: 林铮却是说道：“师父，你传授我的炼丹术，暂时能满足我的炼丹，以后的事情，以后再说。”
不愿意林铮加入丹塔，火玄明白叶青魂也无法破坏丹塔规则，擅自传授自己的弟子炼丹术。
火玄有些好奇的问道：“黎厉亲自前来，看来是有重要事。”
“数年前，黎碧竹在外历练，突然气海出现问题，找过很多的医师都束手无策，我去年亲自去看过，同样没有发现问题。”
“火玄兄，你也是医师，要是不忙的话，不如随我一起去看看，黎厉为人不错，并且厉家有着一门炼丹术。”
并未继续往下说，但叶青魂话里的意思，火玄已经听明白。
为了自己弟子能够得到一门品级不错的炼丹术，火玄点点头，说道：“那我就去看看。”
黎厉已经古稀之年，拄着拐杖，看到走进来的三人，立刻站起身，说道：“叶塔主，还请你救救碧竹。”
“黎兄，这位是来自湮鼎宗的火玄长老，他本身也是一位医师，我们两人随你走一趟，但无法保证。”
黎碧竹的气海伤势已经严重到危及性命，黎厉请了很多的医师都束手无策，无法眼睁睁的看着自己的孙女死去，只能再次登门拜访叶青魂。
黎碧竹的父母黎崇夫妇急忙站起身，朝着叶塔主行礼。
黎厉指着面前床上的少女，声音甚至有些颤抖，说道：“叶塔主，火玄长老，麻烦两位了。”
content_en:
Dilemma.
Lin Zheng said: "Master, the alchemy skills you taught me can satisfy my alchemy skills for the time being. I will talk about the rest later."
Not wanting Lin Zheng to join the Dan Pagoda, Huo Xuan understood that Ye Qinghun could not break the rules of the Dan Pagoda and taught his disciples alchemy without authorization.
"Brother Huo Xuan, there is nothing I can do."
"I understand."
at this moment.
"Master of the Tower, the Master of the Li family is here."
"Please."
Huo Xuan asked curiously: "Li Li came here in person, it seems there is something important."
"For his precious granddaughter Li Bizhu."
"What's going on?"
"A few years ago, Li Bizhu was out training, and suddenly there was a problem with his Qi sea. Many doctors were helpless. I went to see him in person last year, and no problem was found."
"Is it serious?"
"Life-threatening."
"Then I won't bother you."
"Brother Huo Xuan, you are also a doctor. If you are not busy, why not come with me to have a look. Li Li is a good person, and the Li family has an alchemy skill."
He didn't continue, but Huo Xuan understood the meaning of Ye Qinghun's words.
In order for his disciple to obtain a good-level alchemy technique, Huo Xuan nodded and said, "Then I will go and have a look."
In a quaint room.
Li Li, who was already seventy years old and leaning on a cane, stood up immediately when he saw the three people walking in and said, "Master Ye Pagoda, please save Bizhu."
"Brother Li, this is Elder Huoxuan from the Diding Sect. He is also a doctor himself. The two of us will go with you, but there is no guarantee."
"Thank you, Elder Huoxuan."
"Please."
The Li family, the first family in Fengyun City.
White loft exterior.
Li Bizhu's Qi Hai injury was serious enough to endanger his life. Li Li hired many doctors but they were unable to do anything. Unable to watch his granddaughter die, he could only visit Ye Qinghun again.
"Dad."
Li Bizhu's parents, Li Chong and his wife, stood up quickly and saluted Master Ye.
"You two get out of the way."
"Yes."
Li Li pointed at the girl on the bed in front of him, his voice even trembling, and said: "Master Ye Pagoda, Elder Huoxuan, I'm sorry to bother you two."
"Brother Huo Xuan, please."
